### Problem Description
A clear and concise description of the policy requirement, valuation challenge, or feature gap.

### Proposed Solution / Policy Basis
- Which standard or regulatory rule does this relate to (e.g., CAS Guidance No.9, GB/T 46353, local pilot policy)?
- How should the formula or coefficient be calculated?

### Implementation Scope
- [ ] Formula / UI changes in `index.html`
- [ ] AI extraction / reasoning prompt alignment
- [ ] Benchmark case calibration test
